actions.description: BRO-5356 cousin: four Feb 2025 reviews of the Theatre Royal Drury Lane run (Hiddleston/Atwell), which much-ado-about-nothing-2026 lists in priorRuns (2025-02-10 to 2025-04-05). The rebuild released their dateless-revival hold (wrongProduction false) but left contentTier 'invalid' ('Wrong production'), so all four are off the site (explainExclusion contentTierInvalid). No fullText; classifyContentTier gives excerpt from their aggregator excerpts (671-1,085 chars).
